# Tree

> A nested list of items that expand and collapse, to pick one or more from.

`<slab-tree>` · Navigation · built on `[role=tree]`

Docs: https://slab-elements.dev/components/tree/

## Import

```js
import 'slab-elements/tree.js';
import 'slab-elements/tree.item.js';
```

## Usage

```html
<slab-tree label="Files">
  <slab-tree-item expanded>
    src
    <slab-tree-item>index.ts</slab-tree-item>
  </slab-tree-item>
  <slab-tree-item>README.md</slab-tree-item>
</slab-tree>
```

## Keyboard

| Key          | What it does                                                                   |
| ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Up, Down     | Moves through the Tree Items that can be seen, skipping disabled ones.         |
| Home, End    | Moves to the first or last Tree Item.                                          |
| Right        | Expands a collapsed Tree Item, or moves to the first child of an expanded one. |
| Left         | Collapses an expanded Tree Item, or moves to the parent of one that isn't.     |
| *            | Expands every Tree Item with children at the active one's level.               |
| A character  | Moves to the next Tree Item whose label starts with what's typed.              |
| Enter, Space | Selects the active Tree Item, or toggles it when `multiple` is set.            |

With `multiple`, Shift with Up or Down moves and toggles, Shift with Space
selects from the last selected Tree Item to the active one, Control or
Command with Shift and Home or End selects from the active one to the first
or last, and Control or Command with A selects every one, or none.

## Elements

### `<slab-tree>`

Import `slab-elements/tree.js` to register it.

A tree with no visual styles: a `[role=tree]` of Tree Items, which nest, to select one or, when `multiple` is set, more from.

It's the APG's tree view. Focus stays on the tree, and its `aria-activedescendant` points at the active Tree Item, which is the first one or the selected one until the user moves. Down and Up move through the Tree Items that can be seen, skipping disabled ones, and Home and End go to the first and last. Right expands a collapsed Tree Item, or moves to the first child of an expanded one. Left collapses an expanded Tree Item, or moves to the parent of one that isn't. `*` expands every Tree Item with children at the active one's level. Typing moves to the next Tree Item whose label starts with what was typed. Enter, Space and a click select the active Tree Item, and a click expands or collapses one that has children. In a right-to-left tree, Left expands and Right collapses.

When `multiple` is set, Enter, Space and a click toggle the Tree Item instead, and Shift with the Down or Up arrow moves and toggles. Shift with Space selects every Tree Item that can be seen from the one last selected to the active one, and Control or Command with Shift and Home or End selects every one from the active one to the first or last, moving there. Control or Command with A selects every enabled Tree Item, at every depth, or none when they all are already. These are the APG's keys for a multi-select tree.

Style it through its part, and each Tree Item through its own parts and states.

#### Attributes

| Name               | Type      | Default | Description                               |
| ------------------ | --------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| `label` (required) | `string`  |         | Names the tree.                           |
| `multiple`         | `boolean` | `false` | Lets more than one be selected at a time. |

#### Properties

| Name                        | Type               | Description                                         |
| --------------------------- | ------------------ | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `items` (read-only)         | `TreeItem[]`       | Every Tree Item, at every depth, in order.          |
| `selectedItem` (read-only)  | `TreeItem \| null` | The first selected Tree Item, or `null`.            |
| `selectedItems` (read-only) | `TreeItem[]`       | Every selected Tree Item, at every depth, in order. |

#### Methods

| Signature                             | Description                                     |
| ------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `focus(options?: FocusOptions): void` | Focuses it, or the part of it that takes focus. |

#### Events

| Name     | Type    | Description                                                                                            |
| -------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `change` | `Event` | When the user changes its value, as a native control's does. Setting it from code doesn't dispatch it. |

#### Slots

| Name      | Type       | Description |
| --------- | ---------- | ----------- |
| (default) | `TreeItem` |             |

#### CSS parts

| Name   | Description    |
| ------ | -------------- |
| `tree` | The Tree Items |

### `<slab-tree-item>`

Import `slab-elements/tree.item.js` to register it.

A Tree Item with no visual styles. The host is the tree item, so style it directly, and its label and nested Tree Items through its parts.

Tree Items nested in it are its children. Each puts itself in its parent's `item` slot, inside a `[role=group]` that's `display: none` while the parent is collapsed.

It's never focused. Focus stays on its Tree, which points at the active Tree Item with `aria-activedescendant`.

Its Tree sets `:state(active)`. It sets `:state(disabled)`, `:state(expanded)`, `:state(parent)` when it has children, and `:state(selected)` itself.

#### Attributes

| Name       | Type      | Default | Description                                                                                                                               |
| ---------- | --------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Disables it, as `disabled` does a native control: the user can't focus or use it, and a form control's value isn't submitted.             |
| `expanded` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether its children are shown, when it has any.                                                                                          |
| `label`    | `string`  |         | Names the Tree Item in place of its text, and is what typeahead matches against.                                                          |
| `selected` | `boolean` | `false` | Like Option's, the attribute is the default state and the property is the current one. Style `:state(selected)` rather than `[selected]`. |

#### Properties

| Name                | Type         | Description                                                                                   |
| ------------------- | ------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `items` (read-only) | `TreeItem[]` | Its children.                                                                                 |
| `text` (read-only)  | `string`     | What the user reads as the Tree Item's name: its label, or its own text when it has no label. |

#### Slots

| Name      | Type                | Description                                                |
| --------- | ------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- |
| (default) | `Element \| string` | The label, plus anything else a design puts in a Tree Item |
| `item`    | `TreeItem`          | Its children. A nested Tree Item puts itself here.         |

#### CSS parts

| Name    | Description  |
| ------- | ------------ |
| `group` | Its children |
| `label` | The label    |

#### CSS states

| Name               | Description                                                                                     |
| ------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `:state(active)`   | While it's the active one, which the keyboard moves through while focus stays on its container. |
| `:state(disabled)` | While it's disabled.                                                                            |
| `:state(expanded)` | While it's expanded, showing its children.                                                      |
| `:state(parent)`   | While it has child items.                                                                       |
| `:state(selected)` | While it's selected.                                                                            |
